snippet.title: Final Paris board, then a trip to Bern ✈️
snippet.description:
The last level of Paris, France, the Eiffel Tower unlocked and the drive to Bern. Trip Sort is a relaxing triple tile match puzzle with 255 real destinations, and it plays offline.

Free on iPhone and iPad: https://apps.apple.com/app/trip-sort-triple-tile-match/id6818841022
More: https://dezeo.lat/tripsort/

#shorts #tilematch #paris
